title: Beaverbrook Art Gallery
scope: The standing Beaverbrook Art Gallery on Queen Street, including the surviving historic galleries, 2017 east pavilion and 2022 Harrison McCain entrance pavilion.
limitations: The 2005 photo shows older portions before the two latest expansions. The new pavilions follow the named current footprint and the architects’ written descriptions.
The curvature, number and thickness of the entrance fins, east pavilion apertures, exact roof heights and smaller back-of-house details are estimated.
The model represents the gallery itself. Nearby artwork and the Legislative Assembly across Queen Street are outside the building scope.
